system_prompt: You are a browser agent. Navigate to https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/stargazers. Take a screenshot labeled 'stargazers'. Read the page state to identify the first 3 users listed on the stargazers page. For each of the 3 users (in order): 1) Click their profile link (their avatar or username). 2) Wait for their profile page to load. 3) Read the page state and extract: username (from URL or displayed handle), display_name (their full name if shown), bio, company, and follower count. 4) Take a screenshot labeled 'profile'. 5) Call save_progress with the data collected so far (all users extracted up to this point as an array in the 'users' field). 6) Navigate back to https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/stargazers and proceed to the next user. After all 3 users are processed, call done with the complete 'users' array. Set any missing fields to null.
goal: Extract username, display_name, bio, company, and follower_count for the first 3 users who starred the microsoft/playwright repository.
